missing_requirements.requirement: Remove any splash-specific styling/animations so no leftover splash styles affect the app.
missing_requirements.reason: Because the splash component itself still exists (REQ-130 not satisfied) and is described as an animated splash, splash-specific styling/animation is still present in the codebase.

hallucinated_features.description: Startup cleanup that unregisters all service workers and deletes all Cache Storage caches on mount.
